[[Bari Hyman]] }} The '''Filly vendors''' are a group of characters living at the outskirts of [[Filly]] {{In|FOTV}}.{{fotv|1|2}} ==Background== These inhabitants of Filly sell their wares at stalls on the streets leading to Filly's downtown. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Target]]=== As [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]] enters the outskirts of Filly, she passes by various vendors who try to sell their food and wares to [[Filly townsperson|the townfolk]]. Lucy asks one of the vendors who was selling fresh [[iguana-on-a-stick]] for information concerning [[Hank MacLean|her father]], but is brushed off. ==Appearances== Filly vendors appear {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|2=102}} ==Behind the scenes== Four vendors with speaking lines in the episode are played by actors [[Martin Pfefferkorn]], [[David Bluvband]], [[Julian Rozzell Jr.]], and [[Bari Hyman]].
